svg.title: Map of Borealis
svg.desc: A fictional nation of seven provinces. Westhaven on the west coast, Ridgeland east of the mountains, Goldplain on the central prairie, Lakemoor on the great lakes, Valcourt along the river valley, Saltmarch on the Atlantic coast and islands, and Northreach across the whole north. The Southern Republic lies to the south.

g.text: Seven Provinces from Sea to Sea
